CORAM: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA

ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA) Heard Sri.Rajashekhar S.Arani,
learned counsel for the appellant.
No representation on respondents' side on call.
2. This appeal is outcome of the award that is passed by the Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi in M.V.C. No.560/2014 dated 19.11.2014.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the appellant Sri.Rajashekhar S.Arani submits that though the appeal is filed questioning the quantum of amount that is awarded as compensation, having gone through the contents of the impugned order, the appellant is of the view that the award can be satisfied the same being almost reasonable.
Learned counsel thereby seeks to dispose of the appeal accordingly.
NC: 2025:KHC-D:15236 HC-KAR 4.

Having considered the submission thus made and as no grounds are made out to interfere with the impugned order, the appeal is disposed of with the following:
ORDER (i) The appeal is dismissed.
(ii) Amount if any in deposit, be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal forthwith.
